mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the recovery capillaries was most worthwhile: it showed how glucose and water return to the blood after filtration, while fluid continues through the tubule.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the filter cups to the tubules felt like a straightforward assembly step; its result added little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: Seeing useful glucose pass through the filter alongside water and urea clarified why the body needs to reclaim substances afterward.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt arbitrary; their purposes followed from the structures and goals, although several were the only offered action.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it offered a similarly clear explanation of how body systems work together, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the mostly forced sequence here.
